node.title: F2 antipodal-selector prefix transport
node.statement: For a cyclic odd-prefix syndrome map of binary length m, choosing theta^s or -theta^s according to each bit bijects the cube with antipodal transversal m-subsets of mu_(2m). Their even power sums are fixed and their odd power sums are an affine invertible rescaling of the F2 syndrome. Every F2 fiber therefore injects into one ordinary central depth-2R split-locator prefix fiber. This applies to both signed generating branches and their ambient images. No split-locator flatness, normalized-band, structured-owner, or pruned-Q theorem is claimed.
